articles.title: Judge who awarded 36 death sentences in 16 months transferred to family court
articles.description: Judge Ravi Kumar Diwakar has been transferred to the family court after awarding multiple death sentences. He gained national attention for his decisions in Muzaffarnagar, including a notable case of a husband burning his wife. His tenure included recalling numerous pending cases, raising questions regarding administrative authority. Diwakar previously faced threats following his involvement in a high-profile mosque survey case.

articles.title: KL Rahul's horror show: Duck followed by bizarre hit-wicket dismissal
articles.description: KL Rahul struggled in the first unofficial Test against New Zealand A, scoring only four runs in two innings. In the first innings, he was dismissed for a duck after edging a catch to the wicketkeeper. His second innings ended in a bizarre hit-wicket dismissal as he accidentally struck the stumps with his bat. Rahul's two failures contributed to India A's batting collapse in the match.

As of now, there are no reports of damage or injuries.

articles.description: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh has resumed flight operations following a significant security situation. Airlines such as Air India and Air India Express have suspended services to Saudi Arabia as a precaution.

articles.title: France’s economic woes: Debt nears 122% of GDP, growth forecast at just 0.4%
articles.description: France is grappling with severe economic challenges, marked by soaring public debt nearing 122% of GDP. With government expenditure exceeding 57% of the nation's economic output, the forecast of just a 0.4% growth raises concerns over financial stability. Protests centered on the rising cost of living showcase deeper political fractures. As the presidential succession nears, the economy stands as a pivotal issue for the electorate.

articles.title: Sebi plans curbs on terminal misuse, graded compliance for market intermediaries
articles.description: In a proactive move, market regulator Sebi is rolling out initiatives to curb the misuse of brokers' trading terminals and bolster compliance efforts. The focus is also on enhancing cybersecurity while safely testing AI tools. Sebi's vision encompasses streamlining regulations, promoting responsible technology, fostering deeper market engagement, and ensuring broader access for investors, particularly in underrepresented smaller towns and villages, while urging brokers to assess client risks more comprehensively.

articles.title: US Fed expected to hold rates as inflation, energy costs weigh ahead of midterms
articles.description: The US Federal Reserve is expected to keep interest rates unchanged in its upcoming meeting next week. Analysts suggest this decision comes despite ongoing inflation pressures and looming midterm elections. The Federal Reserve has struggled to meet its long-term inflation target due to rising prices affecting multiple sectors. Heightened energy costs after global conflicts are contributing significantly to inflation pressures.

articles.title: IDFC First Bank Q2 profit nearly triples to Rs 1,045 crore; loan assets rise 30%
articles.description: In Q2 FY27, IDFC First Bank showcased an impressive profit surge of 196.5 percent year-on-year, reaching Rs 1,045 crore. The bank's robust core operating performance is highlighted by a 21 percent rise in net interest income. Additionally, total loan assets expanded by 30.1 percent, showcasing substantial business growth. With gross non-performing assets reduced to 1.32 percent, management credits this achievement to effective deposit strategies and anticipated liquidity advantages.

articles.title: Jamia Millia Islamia moves classes online amid row over student protests, safety concerns
articles.description: Jamia Millia Islamia announced the transition to online classes to ensure student safety amid ongoing protests. The protests began after five students initiated an indefinite hunger strike on October 12. Students are demanding the restoration of the Jamia Millia Islamia Students' Union, which was dissolved in 2006. Allegations regarding slogans for a 'Free Kashmir' during demonstrations have been denied by students.

articles.description: Salman Khan has announced a luxury residential project in Punjab amidst security threats. He could not attend the launch event but sent a supportive video message. There is no confirmation yet about any plans to move from his long-time residence.

articles.description: Sudev Nair attributes his increased recognition in the Malayalam film industry to his role in Amal Neerad's Bheeshma Parvam.
